sentences.english_hint: We don’t have time during the day.
sentences.scenario: Explain why daytime classes are difficult.
sentences.source_note: Corrects the recurring fragment 天的时候 when discussing the family schedule.

sentences.chinese: 我跟我太太说，我有中文课。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gēn wǒ tàitai shuō, wǒ yǒu Zhōngwén kè.
sentences.english_hint: I tell my wife I have Chinese class.
sentences.scenario: Tell your wife about your class.
sentences.source_note: Uses the corrected 跟我太太说 structure from the schedule discussion.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de nǚ'ér hái méi qǐchuáng.
sentences.english_hint: My daughter hasn’t got up yet.
sentences.scenario: Explain why the morning is unusually quiet.
sentences.source_note: Analysis corrects 不起床 to 还没起床 for the daughter’s situation.

sentences.pinyin: Zǎoshang bā diǎn wǒ yǒu Zhōngwén kè.
sentences.english_hint: I have Chinese class at eight in the morning.
sentences.scenario: State your current morning class time.
sentences.source_note: Taken from the corrected sentence about telling the learner’s wife the class time.

sentences.chinese: 我想把中文课改到上午十点。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng bǎ Zhōngwén kè gǎi dào shàngwǔ shí diǎn.
sentences.english_hint: I want to move Chinese class to ten a.m.
sentences.scenario: Ask your teacher to move the class later.
sentences.source_note: Direct correction of the learner’s request to reschedule Chinese class.

sentences.chinese: 很多人想在苹果公司工作。
sentences.pinyin: Hěn duō rén xiǎng zài Píngguǒ gōngsī gōngzuò.
sentences.english_hint: Many people want to work at Apple.
sentences.scenario: Explain why many people apply to Apple.
sentences.source_note: Corrects 想工作在苹果 by placing 在苹果公司 before 工作.

sentences.chinese: 我在这家公司工作了四年。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zài zhè jiā gōngsī gōngzuò le sì nián.
sentences.english_hint: I worked at this company for four years.
sentences.scenario: Describe the length of your earlier work experience.
sentences.source_note: Uses the four-year duration and corrected word order from the learner’s work story.

sentences.english_hint: London is as expensive as New York.
sentences.scenario: Compare costs in two cities you discussed.
sentences.source_note: Direct correction of 伦敦比纽约一样.

sentences.pinyin: Nǐ de diànnǎo bù néng yòng le.
sentences.source_note: Analysis corrects 不用 to 不能用 in the technical support story.

sentences.scenario: Offer help with a computer problem.
sentences.source_note: Direct correction of 帮忙你; analysis recommends 帮你.

sentences.pinyin: Gōngsī xiǎng zhāopìn liǎng ge rén.
sentences.english_hint: The company wants to hire two people.
sentences.source_note: Learner discussed recruiting two people; analysis distinguishes 招聘 from 应聘.

sentences.chinese: 我想应聘公司的另一个职位。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng yìngpìn gōngsī de lìng yí ge zhíwèi.
sentences.english_hint: I want to apply for another position at the company.
sentences.scenario: Discuss moving to another job within your company.
sentences.source_note: Analysis supplies this model for the learner’s internal job-change story.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ cānjiā le yí ge zhāopìnhuì.
sentences.scenario: Start telling the story of how you found your job.
sentences.source_note: Shortened from the analysis’s final work-story drill about attending a university job fair.

sentences.chinese: 对我来说，这两个词很像。
sentences.pinyin: Duì wǒ lái shuō, zhè liǎng ge cí hěn xiàng.
sentences.english_hint: To me, these two words are very similar.
sentences.scenario: Discuss 学习 and 休息 with your teacher.
sentences.source_note: Shortens the analysis’s correction of 对我的来说 and 很一样 in the pronunciation discussion.
